bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; amending an appropriation for a wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield; appropriating additional money for the project; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivisions 1, 7.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Total Appropriation

$

120,402,000

To the Public Facilities Authority [+or other named entity +]for the purposes specified in this section.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 2.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 7.
First District Association; Wastewater Industrial Pretreatment Facility

5,000,000

[+To the commissioner of agriculture +]for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield, to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish, a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield with a processing capacity of up to 1,750,000 gallons per day of high strength wastewater, a biosolids handling process, and renewable gas production.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 3. [+APPROPRIATION; WASTEWATER INDUSTRIAL PRETREATMENT FACILITY. +]

[+$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; amending an appropriation for a wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield; appropriating additional money for the project; amending Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivisions 1, 7.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 1, is amended to read:

Subdivision 1.
Total Appropriation

$

120,402,000

To the Public Facilities Authority or other named entity for the purposes specified in this section.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2.
Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, is amended to read:

Subd. 7.
First District Association; Wastewater Industrial Pretreatment Facility

5,000,000

To the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield, to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish, a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield with a processing capacity of up to 1,750,000 gallons per day of high strength wastewater, a biosolids handling process, and renewable gas production.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 3. APPROPRIATION; WASTEWATER INDUSTRIAL PRETREATMENT FACILITY.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of agriculture for a grant to the First District Association, a dairy cooperative located in the city of Litchfield to design, engineer, construct, equip, and furnish a new wastewater industrial pretreatment facility in the city of Litchfield. This appropriation is in addition to the appropriation in Laws 2023, chapter 71, article 1, section 15, subdivision 7, and is for the same purpose.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
